# Regexes (grep -E) matched against changed file paths. If every file in a merge
# group matches, the merge queue skips the integration tests.

# Documentation, licenses and repo metadata
\.md$
^docs/
^etc/
^legal/
^LICENSE
^[^/]+\.(txt|ya?ml|html)$
(^|/)\.gitignore$

# GitHub configuration. The integration test runner workflows and
# .github/scripts/pr-builder.sh, which they run, are deliberately not skipped.
^\.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/
^\.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE
^\.github/CODEOWNERS$
^\.github/claude/
^\.github/[^/]+\.(txt|ya?ml)$
^\.github/workflows/[^i][^/]*\.ya?ml$
^\.github/scripts/(pre-commit-hook\.sh|version_property_finder\.py|zip-based-test-runner\.sh)$

# Folders outside the Maven build used by the integration tests
^oidc-conformance-tests/
^oidc-fapi-conformance-tests/
^product-scenarios/
^jmeter-tests/
^usecases/
^modules/agents/

# Images
\.(png|jpe?g|gif|svg|ico)$
